method.volatility: EWMA of 1h log returns, half-life 24h, read from the last completed hour (lookahead-free)
method.hourly: synthetic single-collateral positions, debt $100k stable, opened every 2 days at 00:00 UTC at HF 1.25/1.5/2, held 30 days untouched; monitor reads each hourly close; liquidation when the hourly LOW takes HF < 1, stamped at the bar open
method.e1: real Aave V3 accounts liquidated Oct 10 2025 (evidence.json cohort: priced, not excluded, WETH/wstETH/WBTC/cbBTC collateral, stable debt); balances held at their liquidation snapshot and re-priced backwards on the mainnet Chainlink feed in force each minute; liquidation time = the real first liquidation
method.e2: real Morpho Blue positions liquidated in Nov 2025 (WBTC/cbBTC/wstETH collateral, stable loan); hourly collateral and borrow from the Morpho API, priced each minute on Binance spot scaled to Morpho collateral USD; liquidation time = the real first liquidation
method.e4: real Morpho PT-reUSD-10DEC2026 positions liquidated Aug 25 2026; hourly collateral/borrow from the Morpho API, priced on the market oracle (archive reads every ~1h, every 5 blocks 01:00-07:00 UTC Aug 25); liquidation time = the real first liquidation
method.falseAlarm: a worsening message at >= the scored level with no liquidation in the next 72h, counted only on positions never liquidated, excluding a message at the first read (a position opened inside a band)

flapping.note: positions opened near the HF bands (1.15/1.2/1.3/1.35) in calm windows: every message counts, clears included

alignment.note: how often the replayed path crosses HF 1 before the real liquidation, and by how much (minutes). A crossing that never happens means the reconstruction is conservative.

rsEthRateProxy.method: median rsETH/ETH (DefiLlama, same source both legs) over Apr 10 → Apr 17 2026, used as the redemption-rate proxy

e3RsEthLoops.note: rsETH collateral / ETH debt, LT 0.93, opened at the pre-incident rate; hourly DefiLlama ratio; warn+ lead to the first market-oracle liquidation

e3ExitCapacity.note: n = 1 episode. Aave V3 USDe cash (USDe.balanceOf(aEthUSDe)) every ~15 min, Apr 10 → Apr 23 2026. Shows timing only; not a validated rate.
